narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to educate female viewers on the specific needs of their bodies regarding intermittent fasting, highlighting that standard research often focuses on men. It introduces a specialized book as a resource and promotes the creator's main YouTube channel for more in-depth content on cyclical health.
